The '''glass key''' was a piece of a technology crafted by the ancient extinct race from the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Simocadia]]. It was used to activate and control [[Ardana Shadex]], immense stone giants that could topple [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Yojan]] used one such key to activate an Ardana Shadex and destroy the [[Agrocite/Legends|agrocite]] [[Mining/Legends|mines]]. However, the key was damaged by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], who was attempting to stop Yojan, and the giant went out of control. The Jedi and the prince decided to work together to disable the enormous machine: Mace went to retrieve the key, while Yojan went inside the Ardana Shadex through its [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]] and used the key to activate the dead switch. The resulting explosions destroyed the giant, [[Death/Legends|killing]] the prince who was still inside it.
